about: Corrections LazyMapLayers applies to historical-basemaps when it builds the historical borders pack (tools/build-history-pack.ts, src/core/history/historyPack.ts). A year with 'from' is derived from that source snapshot as it came. Every op must find what it names, or the build stops. Fixes to source years are also sent upstream.
